observed_defect: The user-provided Google Chrome/Facebook results showed that source lookup had not been requested, the intended post-context presentation was incomplete, and later returned links could be credible-domain results that were insufficiently related to the supplied post.
root_cause: The in-page flow did not expose the persisted source preference before the request, the result renderer did not implement the required post-context and ordered result contract, and retrieval filtered publisher domains without an explicit title/snippet relevance gate.
fix_implemented: Version 1.3.1 restores bounded selected-post metadata, uses the exact eight-part result order, enables the visible Serper setting once on update, and offers a source-only lookup after analysis without invoking the classifier. The backend now rejects and ranks candidates using distinct informative term matches between the post and result title/snippet. Google Fact Check is no longer a public result panel.
reason_not_passed: The corrected build passed isolated Edge Chromium tests, but the user has not yet reloaded version 1.3.1 and retested it against the current live Facebook DOM in Google Chrome.
automated_evidence_that_does_not_count_a: The rebuilt action popup passed against the actual local API, including exact order, seven feature values, language switching and source-only lookup without another inference request.
The real content script passed on a local HTTPS facebook.com fixture with bounded caption extraction, visible author/timestamp/scope/links, the exact modal order and bilingual result stability.

The screenshot post text produced the same model_4 probability through the API and extension UI: P(Misleading) 0.9977805021719399 and displayed score 99.78%; this confirms the reported label is model behavior rather than a UI substitution.

A live source-only request for the screenshot post returned the directly related Manila Bulletin article '3 killed, including minor, in QC shooting; suspect arrested' with its URL, matching snippet and date, and reported classification_performed=false.

The lower-context query now returns only the directly related Manila Bulletin follow-up 'QCPD files murder raps vs suspect in Batasan Hills shooting'; unrelated court, car-theft, corporate-PDF, tag-page and pickpocket results were rejected.
manual_steps_remaining: Open chrome://extensions and enable Developer mode.
Click Reload on SuriPH, or choose Load unpacked and select chrome-extension/dist.
Confirm the extension shows version 1.3.1, then reload the Facebook tab.
Open the green S control, review the bounded caption text, choose whether to send up to 500 characters to Serper, and analyze.
Confirm the order is prediction, score, post context, collapsed features, related sources, analyzed text, one reminder, then Check again.
If lookup was off, click Find related sources and confirm the label and score do not change.
Test selected text, one caption, one image and one short video against the current Facebook DOM; verify the exact analyzed text and acquisition scope.
Switch English and Tagalog and confirm the English prediction label, score, source titles and analyzed text remain unchanged.
